description: Host Windows PowerShell 5.1 inside the Undertow agent process for one-shot scripts and a persistent live shell; no powershell.exe is launched.
help:
WHAT IT IS
ShellPower loads the .NET CLR and Windows PowerShell 5.1 into the remote Undertow agent process. It does not start powershell.exe or pwsh.exe.

MODULE RUN
Choose Inline PowerShell for a command or complete source text, or choose PowerShell script (.ps1) to send a local script body. The script bytes execute in memory and no .ps1 is created on the agent. Scripts may be UTF-8 or BOM-marked UTF-16LE and are limited to 64 KiB.

LIVE SHELL
Agents > Live shell > ShellPower opens one persistent in-process runspace, so variables, functions, location changes, and imported modules remain available between commands.

PATCHING
Before invoking PowerShell, ShellPower attempts its original two native AMSI patches plus PowerShell ETW, transcription, execution-policy, and constrained-language changes. The native AMSI changes modify amsi.dll in the Undertow process and remain until that agent process exits. PowerShell-specific changes are resolved through the ShellPower AppDomain and reapplied for each new run or session. A patch warning means that specific technique could not be confirmed; execution continues.

DISK AND PROCESS
Undertow temporarily writes and loads the packaged native DLL on the agent, then deletes it after a module run or when a live session closes. The PowerShell source is not written as a script file.
